title: How to sleep train your baby: a practical starting point for parents of babies 4 months plus

emails.subject: A free baby sleep webinar with Sally this Wednesday
emails.preview: Wednesday October 07 at 11 am Melbourne time. Parents of babies 4 months plus.
paragraphs: Join Sally for a free webinar: How to sleep train your baby: a practical starting point for parents of babies 4 months plus.
We meet on Wednesday October 07 at 11 am Melbourne time. Allow 50 minutes: 35 minutes of teaching, 5 minutes about Camp Snooze and 10 minutes for questions.
Sally is an internationally certified sleep consultant and former paediatric nurse. She'll also introduce Camp Snooze, which starts Monday October 19.
Register below to receive your joining details.
